row:
PACC911 is a nonprofit 501(c)3  animal welfare coalition of over 140 animal rescue groups in the greater Phoenix area. 

We fulfill four vital community functions. Large-scale pet adoption events (Adoptathons); Education about Animal Welfare (particularly the need to spay and neuter); A Pet Food Pantry, Chuck Waggin'  supporting families in need to feed pets during financial difficulties; And most of all, we fundraise to provide much-needed Medical Assistance funds for our coalition partners. 

Veterinary expenses can be daunting and the biggest challenge to rescuers. Our coalition groups depend on our raised funds to help them save neglected, abused and abandoned animals and ultimately place them in loving homes.  We have fundraised over 8 million dollars since we've started, and in 2023 alone PACC911 partners have saved 36,000 animals in Arizona. 

Please visit PACC911.org to learn more about us.
